// Command malformed records how the original go.etcd.io/raft/v3 v3.6.0
// raftpb decodes damaged and hostile encodings: for each input, the error
// it returns, or the re-encoding and String() of what it decoded. The fork
// must behave identically, except that it rejects Responses nested more
// than raftpb.MaxMessageNesting deep.
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"compress/gzip"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"os"

	pb "go.etcd.io/raft/v3/raftpb"
)

type msg interface {
	Marshal() ([]byte, error)
	Unmarshal([]byte) error
	String() string
	Size() int
}

func fresh(typ string) msg {
	switch typ {
	case "Entry":
		return &pb.Entry{}
	case "Message":
		return &pb.Message{}
	case "HardState":
		return &pb.HardState{}
	case "ConfState":
		return &pb.ConfState{}
	case "Snapshot":
		return &pb.Snapshot{}
	case "SnapshotMetadata":
		return &pb.SnapshotMetadata{}
	case "ConfChange":
		return &pb.ConfChange{}
	case "ConfChangeSingle":
		return &pb.ConfChangeSingle{}
	case "ConfChangeV2":
		return &pb.ConfChangeV2{}
	}
	panic(typ)
}

type out struct {
	Type string `json:"type"`
	Kind string `json:"kind"`
	Hex  string `json:"hex"`
	Err  string `json:"err,omitempty"`
	Re   string `json:"re,omitempty"`
	Text string `json:"text,omitempty"`
	Size int    `json:"size,omitempty"`
}

var rng = rand.New(rand.NewSource(20261013))

func uvarint(v uint64) []byte { return binary.AppendUvarint(nil, v) }

// field returns a tag for field number f and wire type w.
func tag(f, w uint64) []byte { return uvarint(f<<3 | w) }

func randomField() []byte {
	f := uint64(rng.Intn(20))
	if rng.Intn(10) == 0 {
		f = rng.Uint64() >> uint(rng.Intn(64))
	}
	w := uint64(rng.Intn(8))
	b := tag(f, w)
	switch w {
	case 0:
		b = append(b, uvarint(rng.Uint64()>>uint(rng.Intn(64)))...)
	case 1:
		b = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint64(b, rng.Uint64())
	case 2:
		n := rng.Intn(8)
		b = append(b, uvarint(uint64(n))...)
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			b = append(b, byte(rng.Intn(256)))
		}
	case 3: // start group, maybe with its end
		if rng.Intn(2) == 0 {
			b = append(b, tag(f, 4)...)
		}
	case 5:
		b = binary.LittleEndian.AppendUint32(b, rng.Uint32())
	}
	return b
}

func mutate(b []byte) (string, []byte) {
	c := append([]byte(nil), b...)
	switch k := rng.Intn(12); k {
	case 0:
		if len(c) == 0 {
			return "empty", c
		}
		return "truncate", c[:rng.Intn(len(c))]
	case 1:
		if len(c) == 0 {
			return "empty", c
		}
		i := rng.Intn(len(c))
		c[i] ^= 1 << uint(rng.Intn(8))
		return "bitflip", c
	case 2:
		if len(c) == 0 {
			return "empty", c
		}
		i := rng.Intn(len(c))
		c[i] = byte(rng.Intn(256))
		return "byte", c
	case 3:
		i := rng.Intn(len(c) + 1)
		return "insert", append(c[:i], append([]byte{byte(rng.Intn(256))}, b[i:]...)...)
	case 4:
		if len(c) == 0 {
			return "empty", c
		}
		i := rng.Intn(len(c))
		return "delete", append(c[:i], c[i+1:]...)
	case 5:
		return "unknown-field", append(c, randomField()...)
	case 6:
		f := randomField()
		return "unknown-field-first", append(f, c...)
	case 7: // a huge or negative length on a length-delimited field
		var f uint64 = []uint64{1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 9, 12, 14}[rng.Intn(8)]
		vals := []uint64{1 << 31, 1<<63 - 1, 1 << 63, ^uint64(0), uint64(len(c) + 1), 1 << 40}
		x := append(tag(f, 2), uvarint(vals[rng.Intn(len(vals))])...)
		return "huge-length", append(c, x...)
	case 8: // an overlong varint: eleven continuation bytes
		f := uint64(1 + rng.Intn(14))
		x := tag(f, 0)
		for i := 0; i < 10+rng.Intn(3); i++ {
			x = append(x, 0xff)
		}
		x = append(x, 0x01)
		return "overlong-varint", append(c, x...)
	case 9: // a varint with redundant zero continuation bytes
		f := uint64(1 + rng.Intn(14))
		x := append(tag(f, 0), 0x81, 0x80, 0x80, 0x00)
		return "padded-varint", append(c, x...)
	case 10: // wrong wire type for a known field
		f := uint64(1 + rng.Intn(14))
		w := uint64(rng.Intn(6))
		x := append(tag(f, w), 0x00)
		return "wrong-wire", append(c, x...)
	default:
		n := rng.Intn(24)
		r := make([]byte, n)
		rng.Read(r)
		return "random", r
	}
}

func main() {
	in, err := os.Open("../golden.jsonl")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	f, err := os.Create("malformed.jsonl.gz")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	zw, _ := gzip.NewWriterLevel(f, gzip.BestCompression)
	enc := json.NewEncoder(zw)
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(in)
	sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 1<<20), 1<<24)
	n, accepted := 0, 0
	kinds := map[string]int{}
	for sc.Scan() {
		var g struct{ Type, Hex string }
		if err := json.Unmarshal(sc.Bytes(), &g); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		raw, _ := hex.DecodeString(g.Hex)
		if len(raw) > 4096 {
			continue
		}
		for k := 0; k < 6; k++ {
			kind, b := mutate(raw)
			// Sometimes stack a second mutation.
			if rng.Intn(4) == 0 {
				var k2 string
				k2, b = mutate(b)
				kind += "+" + k2
			}
			o := out{Type: g.Type, Kind: kind, Hex: hex.EncodeToString(b)}
			m := fresh(g.Type)
			if err := m.Unmarshal(b); err != nil {
				o.Err = err.Error()
			} else {
				re, err := m.Marshal()
				if err != nil {
					panic(err)
				}
				o.Re, o.Text, o.Size = hex.EncodeToString(re), m.String(), m.Size()
				accepted++
			}
			kinds[kind]++
			if err := enc.Encode(o); err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			n++
		}
	}
	zw.Close()
	f.Close()
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%d inputs, %d accepted\n", n, accepted)
}
